title: a TLS read interrupted by a timeout or a cancelled task does not lose the data that arrives later
purpose: Exercise a protocol boundary against a suite-owned loopback fixture.

provenance.expected_basis: The fixture sends `late!` 0.8 s after the handshake. A read bounded to 0.1 s times out, a read in a cancelled task ends Cancelled, and the next read receives the 5 bytes: TLS keeps received records, and a cancelled read gives up nothing it already took.
